cpmplus.w5vis.menu.reactions.desc: "When [helmet, elytra, damage...] then hide/show these parts"
cpmplus.w5vis.menu.showHide.desc: The selected parts appear or disappear in the selected animation (Animate mode)
cpmplus.w5vis.menu.form: Create form with its own movement...
cpmplus.w5vis.menu.form.desc: The part walks/runs differently while a button is on (hidden copy + visibility swap)
cpmplus.w5vis.rootBlocked: "%s" is a Minecraft body part: CPM can't hide it with an animation. Choose a part inside it.
cpmplus.w5vis.separate.desc: When another animation moves the part, the visible/hidden goes on an empty group "<part>_vis" around it, so the part never pops up in game by mistake (+1 element).
cpmplus.w5vis.impact: This changes the default of %s: hidden in first person, in the model menu and in %s other animation(s) that have no visible/hidden key on it: %s. Continue?
cpmplus.w5vis.priorityFull: Not possible: another animation on these parts already uses the highest priority CPM allows (127). Lower its priority first.
cpmplus.w5vis.layerCapacity: Warning: the model now has %s layer-controlled animations but only %s free skin layers; CPM won't export it like this. Free more skin layers (CPM+ > Model settings) or turn "layer controlled" off on some animation.
cpmplus.w5vis.warn.copiesVis: "%s" copies the visibility of another part (Copy Transform): separating it would change the result. Skipped.
cpmplus.w5vis.warn.copyVisRedirected: Copy Transform of "%s" now copies the visibility from "%s".
cpmplus.w5vis.warn.copyVisFollower: "%s" copies visibility AND movement from "%s": check its Copy Transform (the visibility now lives in "%s").
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.title: Automatic reactions
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.intro: Each reaction is an animation of its own that CPM plays by itself in that situation (additive, loops, priority above the animations that move these parts).
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.noConflicts: No conflict: no two reactions act on the same part.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.conflict: "%s" and "%s" both act on %s: the one with the higher priority (then the one that started last) wins.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.when.speak: talking in voice chat (needs a voice mod)
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.note.headPair: Helmet and head/pumpkin never trigger together: wearing a head cancels the helmet rule. Use "helmet OR head/pumpkin" for both.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.note.skull: To hide the WHOLE head with a skull, CPM has its own option "Hide head with skull" (no animation needed).
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.note.chestPair: With elytra the chestplate rule does not trigger; use "chestplate OR elytra".
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.note.material: CPM does not know the armor material (iron, diamond...): every armor piece counts.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.note.hurt: Taking damage lasts about half a second.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.note.speak: Only works with a voice mod (e.g. Simple Voice Chat).
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.note.show: Show: outside the situation these parts become hidden by default (first person, menu and the other animations). You will confirm the list.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.note.priority: The priority is set above every animation that moves these parts, so walking/running never cancels the reaction.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.skullHead: To hide the whole head when wearing a head/pumpkin, use CPM's own option "Hide head with skull" instead of an animation (the Minecraft head can't be hidden by animation).
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.skullAlreadyOn: "Hide head with skull" is already on.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.restoreHidden: Also make the parts it showed visible by default again
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.noRule: That reaction does not exist anymore.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.subFrame: That range is shorter than one frame of the animation (%s s): make it longer or raise the animation's snapping (fps).
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.testing: Test: the screen shows "%s" on. Click "Stop test" to go back.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.overridden: Reaction "%s" may be overridden by "%s" (priority %s >= %s): while it plays, the reaction may not show in game.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.overridden.consequence: In game the animation with the higher priority decides what is visible.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37.raisePreview: Raise the priority of "%s" above them
cpmplus.w5vis.g37a.title: Show/hide in this animation
cpmplus.w5vis.g37a.grid: Times snap to the export grid (1/%s s).
cpmplus.w5vis.g37a.hideOutside: Outside this animation, the parts stay hidden
cpmplus.w5vis.g37a.impactNote: This changes the part's default: it disappears in first person, in the menu and in every other animation without its own visible key. You will confirm the list.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37a.replace: Replace the visible/hidden keys these parts already have here
cpmplus.w5vis.g37a.replace.desc: Off = combine: keys outside the chosen time stay as they are.
cpmplus.w5vis.g37a.done: visibility set from %s s to %s s
cpmplus.w5vis.g37a.otherAnim: The animation "%s" also keys "%s" with an equal or higher priority: in game it may change the visibility while it plays.
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.title: Form with its own movement
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.intro: CPM can't give a button its own walking. So: the part is copied (same place, same pivot), the copy stays hidden, and the button swaps them: ON = the copy appears and the original disappears. Then edit the COPY's movement in the situations below.
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.name: Button name
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.copyAll: ALL tracks of the original are copied to the copy in every animation (so the form never freezes); the checked situations are just where you will edit it.
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.cost: Duplicates %s part(s) · the model will have %s parts
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.costAmber: Above 256: players on the default safety settings may see the vanilla skin (you and friends with safety off see it fine). Heavy models also cost FPS. See "Who sees my model?".
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.undo: Create form with its own movement
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.done: form "%s" created (priority %s): now edit the copy's movement
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.root: "%s" is a Minecraft body part and can't be hidden by animation. Put its movement in a sub-group, or use a "_dup" copy of the part.
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.broken: The form "%s" lost its original or its copy (deleted or replaced): its button won't swap anything.
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.flicker: The form "%s" may flicker or disappear while "%s" plays (same or higher priority on its parts).
cpmplus.w5vis.g28.raisePreview: Raise the priority of the form "%s"
